text.aria-label: Title text 'Measured farm output minus the engines' output, by irradiance, farms A to F. Engines tuned before 2025-09, scored 2025-09 to 2026-08. Line: mean. Shade: 95% interval from resampling months. Dashed: the 5-point departure. Below zero: the engine predicts more than the farm produced.'
text.tspan: Measured farm output minus the engines' output, by irradiance, farms A to F.
Engines tuned before 2025-09, scored 2025-09 to 2026-08. Line: mean.
Shade: 95% interval from resampling months. Dashed: the 5-point departure.
Below zero: the engine predicts more than the farm produced.
